cards.title: Do radar patterns repeat?
cards.baseline: Baseline: "no motion" (skill 0). Block ρ 0.31 · κ 0.14. Post-hoc deramp: ρ 0.52, still fails.
cards.plain: Radar can't yet tell stable from degrading ground here at 80 m.
cards.method: Sensitivity to warmth fitted on Sentinel-1 2021–23, tested on 2024–25 at 500 m blocks; 95% block-bootstrap intervals.

cards.title: Does NISAR agree?
cards.baseline: Needs a connected series of at least five dates.
cards.plain: One pair failed to unwrap and several lost coherence, so 2026 has no connected series.
cards.method: NISAR 2026 12-day pairs, ionosphere-corrected, ordering compared with the Sentinel-1 fit at 500 m blocks.

cards.title: Does radar match the boreholes?
cards.baseline: Rule fixed before running: ρ ≥ 0.4 consistent, ≤ 0 not consistent. 11 highway boreholes (about 6 separate places).
cards.plain: Ice-rich boreholes did not sink more on radar; if anything less. Radar movement doesn't track measured ground ice here.
cards.method: Top-5 m moisture content from NWT Permafrost Database logs (ITH 2013 and 2017 drilling, data owner GNWT) against radar summer sinking within 120 m.

cards.title: Predict where radar can't see
cards.baseline: Needs 300 measured examples of degrading ground in 15 blocks.
cards.plain: Too few examples to learn from, so no predicted layer exists.
cards.method: Random forest on terrain, water and vegetation, tested on held-out 2 km blocks (not run).

cards.title: Can we forecast the shoreline?
cards.plain: The 30 m satellite waterline is too noisy. Arrival years are hidden; measured change is shown instead.
cards.method: 207 transects; trend fitted on 1985–2004 waterlines, checked at every date 2005–2025.

cards.title: Reindeer Point reports
cards.baseline: Needs the ground prediction. A consistency check, never proof.
cards.plain: Homes sit on gravel pads; at 80 m radar can't separate pad settling from ground thaw.
cards.method: Share of measured Reindeer Point cells classed degrading, against public reports (Canadian Geographic, Oct 2026).

cards.title: Is the radar processing right?
cards.baseline: HyP3's own displacement maps (slope must be 1.00 ± 0.01).
cards.plain: Our processing matches the provider's maps; the airport reads zero, lakes are masked, no unwrapping jumps.

deviations.what: Training years 2021-2023 instead of 2018-2023; min_seasons 3 instead of 4
deviations.why: Sentinel-1 2018-2020 were never processed by HyP3 (no Earthdata access overnight); only three training summers exist

deviations.what: Thaw onset from air temperature only
deviations.why: Station snow depth reports 3-4 cm in late June at 14 C daily mean; judged unusable on training data

deviations.what: Computation on the shared EPSG:4326 grid with distances and blocks from UTM 8N cell coordinates
deviations.why: Part 1 and Part 2 rasters are on the shared grid; every distance is still in metres

deviations.what: Confidence c_fit floor uses tau instead of 2*sigma_ref
deviations.why: Motion is referenced to the airport, so sigma_ref is ~0 and the spec formula would give zero confidence to every stable cell

deviations.what: Test B uses NISAR sensitivity from 12-day increments; the class comparison (kappa) is not available
deviations.why: The 2026 NISAR chain breaks (24 Aug-5 Sep pair failed to unwrap; several pairs lost coherence), so no cell has the five connected dates the class rules need
NISAR 2026 has no connected series of three or more passes over most of the area

deviations.what: Model C uses the satellite waterline 1985-2025; hindcast fits <= 2004 and predicts 2005-2025 (spec: air photos 1947-1985 fit)
deviations.why: Automatic air-photo shorelines failed visual review (traced mosaic edges and an inner harbour); decided before any hindcast error was seen

deviations.what: Sentinel-1 2022 to mid-2025 cover only the northern half of the area (town); the highway corridor has 2021 and 2025 only
deviations.why: HyP3 products for those dates were single-frame; corridor cells fall back to short-record rules

limits: Motion is relative to a reference area (airport gravel pad)
A screen for where to look, not a sign-off
what_still_works: Height above sea, distance to the 2025 shoreline, measured shoreline change and distance to the highway are measured directly. The screen leans on these.
what_we_dont_predict: Ground condition under a single house
Sudden collapse or the damage from one storm
